turns.speaker: Emily
turns.text: Hello everyone. My name is Emily Kenison. I am the founder of Robecurls, the heatless curling headband. We are a trailblazing company that is redefining how women are styling their hair with our patented line of heatless curling headbands and beyond. So in the US, you got 65 million women waking up every morning, styling their hair with a curling iron. They're using 400 degree heat that is just burning, frying your hair. It's irreparable damage. On top of it, it takes about an hour to use. Women have always been frustrated with this, and there is now a new shift in trend where women are putting down the hot tools. Look at Gen Z: you got 40% of Gen Z reducing the amount of hot tools that they've been using in the past five years. Massive shift in the industry. So I invented the heatless curling headband, patented it, and I did it to solve my own frustrations. I also recognized that this trend was happening. So when we launched this baby, we were first to market and we were best in market. Now with only 90 seconds of effort, you can create curls that last five times longer than your curling iron, with zero heat, zero damage, and you can do it any time, anywhere. As you can see, I'm wearing it right now.
